excerpt.zh: 这不是一个崛起的文明，而是一个被释放的文明。当休眠仓开启，他们醒来时，早已物换星移，故土难寻。但他们的过去并未湮灭，而是埋藏在星系尘土与废墟之下，静候再次被发掘。
excerpt.en: This civilization did not rise; it was released. As the stasis pods unlocked, they awakened to a world aged beyond recognition. Yet all is not lost. Scattered beneath dust and ruin across the galaxy, their past endures, waiting to be rediscovered.

sections.zh:
我们苏醒之时，只能依稀感知自己曾经沉眠。即便如今，我们对往昔最确凿的证据，也并非记忆本身，而是那保存休眠躯体的庞大而精密的科技体系。

成千上万的休眠舱，贯穿地下的传热系统，翻腾不息的熔岩之炉。墙壁上刻满了我们的起源痕迹：舰队自逐渐冷却的母星启程，奔赴群星之间，追寻新的温暖。为了寻找真相，我们离开了这座地下“孵化室”。在[owner.Capital.GetName]的地表，我们找到了可用的科技与资源，也在行星地壳深处探测到更多隐藏的设施。我们的同族或许正在其中一些设施中安眠。

那群星呢？是否在遥远的虚空中，还有如我们一般沉睡的族群？若真如此，也许他们能助我们解开那个自觉醒起便萦绕心头的疑问——我们是谁？
sections.en:
We woke with only the faintest sense that we had ever fallen asleep. Even now, our strongest evidence of a time before comes not from our own memories, but from the complex technology that preserved us in stasis.

Thousands upon thousands of pods, massive heat-transfer systems, cauldrons churning molten rock. Beyond these bare mechanisms, clues to our origin were inscribed in the walls: fleets of ships, scattering from cooling worlds to seek warmth among the stars. In search of answers, we left this underground 'birthing chamber.' Across the surface of [owner.Capital.GetName] we discovered useful technology and resources. We have also found evidence of further facilities nestled within the planet's crust. Some hold sleepers we might welcome as kin.

And what of the stars? Are there others like us, still sleeping? If they exist, perhaps they can help us answer our most burning question: who are we?
